title: CCST Networking Reviewer 1
description: Networking review questions covering standard concepts, security, endpoints and media types, infrastructure, and troubleshooting for CCST preparation.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a characteristic of the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP)?

choices.text: Prevents loops in a network by blocking redundant links
Provides load balancing across multiple paths in a network
Prioritizes network traffic based on Quality of Service (QoS) settings
Allows for rapid convergence by eliminating the need for spanning tree calculations

questions.prompt: What information is contained in the MAC address table of a switch?

choices.text: Dynamically learned Layer 2 and Layer 3 addresses of devices communicating on active ports on the switch
The MAC addresses of devices communicating on active ports and static MAC addresses configured by the administrator
All active ports on the switch and the host Layer 3 addresses that were dynamically learned on each port
MAC-address-to-IP-address mappings learned through ARP requests or manually configured by the administrator

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a subnet mask?

choices.text: Determine the network portion of an IP address
Determine the host portion of an IP address
Determine the default gateway for a network
Determine the DNS server for a network

choices.text: Ensures data is available for access by providing redundant systems
Ensures data is not changed during transit between systems
Ensures data is kept secret using safeguards to prevent unauthorized access
Ensures data is trusted and has not been tampered with or changed

questions.prompt: A support technician examines the front panel of a Cisco switch and sees four Ethernet cables connected in the first four ports. Ports 1, 2, and 3 have a green LED. Port 4 has a blinking green light. What is the state of Port 4?
